Tamil Nadu Power Distribution Corporation Ltd (TNPDCL) has published the Recruitment 2026 notification for 500 Diploma Apprentice posts. The online application process will be conducted from 28 October 2026 to 28 November 2026. Eligible candidates can apply through the official website, nats.education.gov.in.

📋 COMPLETE POST DESCRIPTION & OFFICIAL DETAILS

📅 Important Dates
  • Post Release / Update Date: 28 Oct 2026
  • Apply Online Start Date: 28 Oct 2026
  • Last Date to Apply: 28 Nov 2026
💳 Application Fee
  • Employment News
  • Monthly stipend Rs.10900/
  • Electrical and Electronics Engineering 455 Rs.10900/
  • Electronics and Communication Engineering 35 Rs.10900/
  • Computer Engineering / Information Technology 10 Rs.10900/
  • BC/MBC candidates who claim the OBC (Non-creamy layer) category must bring an OBC (NCL) certificate in the approved format from the certificate issuing authority.
  • Community certificate in the Government standard format (SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/PwD), or an OBC (NCL) certificate in the approved format for BC/MBC candidates claiming OBC (NCL)
🎓 Qualification & Eligibility
  • Eligibility
  • Post Diploma (Technician) Apprentice - Engineering
  • A Diploma in Engineering or Technology (Regular - Full time) in the relevant discipline, granted by a State Council or Board of Technical Education set up by a State Government.
  • A Diploma in Engineering or Technology (Regular - Full time) in the relevant discipline, granted by a University.
  • A Diploma in Engineering and Technology granted by an institution that the State Government or Central Government recognises as equivalent to the above.
  • Shortlisting: BOAT (SR) draws up a shortlist from the online application data. It is based on your percentage of marks in the basic qualification for your discipline.
  • When the apprenticeship ends, TNPDCL (TNEB LIMITED / TNPDCL / TNPGCL / TNGECL / TANTRANSCO) has no obligation to offer you a job. Finishing the apprenticeship does not give you a right to employment.
  • Diploma Provisional Certificate or Consolidated Mark Sheet

🎯 90-DAY MASTER PREPARATION ROADMAP

  • Month 1 (Days 1–30 | Foundation & Core Syllabus): Arithmetic & Advance Maths के सभी फॉर्मूले, Reasoning के Coding-Decoding/Series/Analogy पैटर्न, और NCERT आधारित Static GK व Science के मुख्य कॉन्सेप्ट्स पूरे करें।
  • Month 2 (Days 31–60 | Speed, PYQs & Sectional Mastery): पिछले 5 वर्षों के Official Previous Year Questions (PYQs) को टाइमर के साथ हल करें। Calculation Speed बढ़ाने के लिए Tables, Squares, Cubes और Fraction-to-Percentage रोज़ दोहराएं।
  • Month 3 (Days 61–90 | Full-Length Mocks & High-Yield Revision): रोज़ाना 1-2 Full CBT Mock Tests का गहन विश्लेषण (Deep Analysis) करें, कमज़ोर टॉपिक्स पर 50-50 सवाल हल करें और पिछले 1 वर्ष के Current Affairs व Static GK को पक्का करें।

🎯 90-DAY MASTER PREPARATION ROADMAP

  • Month 1 (Days 1–30 | Foundation & Core Syllabus): Arithmetic & Advance Maths के सभी फॉर्मूले, Reasoning के Coding-Decoding/Series/Analogy पैटर्न, और NCERT आधारित Static GK व Science के मुख्य कॉन्सेप्ट्स पूरे करें।
  • Month 2 (Days 31–60 | Speed, PYQs & Sectional Mastery): पिछले 5 वर्षों के Official Previous Year Questions (PYQs) को टाइमर के साथ हल करें। Calculation Speed बढ़ाने के लिए Tables, Squares, Cubes और Fraction-to-Percentage रोज़ दोहराएं।
  • Month 3 (Days 61–90 | Full-Length Mocks & High-Yield Revision): रोज़ाना 1-2 Full CBT Mock Tests का गहन विश्लेषण (Deep Analysis) करें, कमज़ोर टॉपिक्स पर 50-50 सवाल हल करें और पिछले 1 वर्ष के Current Affairs व Static GK को पक्का करें।
